Message.MsgText: The connector will try to reprocess message: msgID.
The connector will delete message: msgID.
An HTTP client connection failed with error: exception
Error checking task failed with error: exception
Message: msgID from External system: extSys is with status 'HOLD'.

Explanation.p: The IF server could not reprocess an output queue message flagged with error.

OperatorResponse.p: Set Action on error parameter to Retry/Delete or manually retry/delete the message from Message Reprocessing application.

Message.MsgText: The variable name parameter must be set to use the Connector.

Explanation.p: This error occurs if the required parameters for the connector are empty.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the required parameters for the connector.

Message.MsgText: The variable name parameter must be set to a valid number.

Explanation.p: This error occurs if the parameter value is not valid.

OperatorResponse.p: It should be a valid number.

Message.MsgText: The variable name parameter value must be within Minimum Value to Maximum Value.

Explanation.p: This error occurs if the parameter value is not within minimum and maximum values defined.

OperatorResponse.p: The parameter value should be with in minimum and maximum values defind.
